ucs.title: [LLM] Mustang Panda PlugX/TONESHELL DLL side-loading via signed binary running from non-standard path
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature execution pattern: a legitimately-signed third-party binary (Adobe, ESET, Avast, Realtek, NVIDIA, etc.) copied to %APPDATA%, %ProgramData%, %TEMP% or a USB root and used to side-load a malicious DLL that decrypts a PlugX/TONESHELL/PUBLOAD payload. This binary-swap pattern is the single most consistent Mustang Panda / Bronze President / Earth Preta tradecraft across the past 5+ years of campaigns reported by Trend Micro, Mandiant, ESET and Recorded Future.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commandlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AdobeUpdate.exe","AdobeARM.exe","AcroRd32.exe","hkcmd.exe","RasTls.exe","AvastSvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","AvastEmUpdate.exe","ESET.exe","ESETOnlineScanner.exe","RtkAudUService64.exe","nvSmartMax.exe","NvSmart.exe","NVDisplay.Container.exe","BugSplatRC.exe","GUP.exe","vmtoolsd.exe") NOT (Processes.process_path="C:\\Program Files\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\Windows\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_path as path | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["AdobeUpdate.exe","AdobeARM.exe","AcroRd32.exe","hkcmd.exe","RasTls.exe","AvastSvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","AvastEmUpdate.exe","ESET.exe","ESETOnlineScanner.exe","RtkAudUService64.exe","nvSmartMax.exe","NvSmart.exe","NVDisplay.Container.exe","BugSplatRC.exe","GUP.exe","vmtoolsd.exe"]);
let SideloadProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\"
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\"
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\"
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessId, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
SideloadProcs
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !in~ ("Adobe Inc.","Adobe Systems Incorporated","ESET, spol. s r.o.","AVAST Software","Realtek Semiconductor","NVIDIA Corporation","VMware, Inc.","Microsoft Corporation")
    | project Timestamp1=Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, LoadedDll=FileName, DllFolderPath=FolderPath, DllSHA256=SHA256
) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where DllFolderPath =~ FolderPath  // sibling DLL — classic side-load layout
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, SideloadHost=FileName, HostPath=FolderPath, SHA256, LoadedDll, DllSHA256, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["AdobeUpdate.exe","AdobeARM.exe","AcroRd32.exe","hkcmd.exe","RasTls.exe","AvastSvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","AvastEmUpdate.exe","ESET.exe","ESETOnlineScanner.exe","RtkAudUService64.exe","nvSmartMax.exe","NvSmart.exe","NVDisplay.Container.exe","BugSplatRC.exe","GUP.exe","vmtoolsd.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinaryName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where BinaryName in~ (SideloadHosts)
| where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files\"
| where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\"
| where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Windows\"
| where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\") or NewProcessName matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName, BinaryName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Mustang Panda PlugX/TONESHELL Side-Load Host From Non-Standard Path
id: 8a2e9b3c-7c41-4d5e-9c1b-mustangpanda01
status: experimental
description: Detects renamed/relocated copies of signed binaries Mustang Panda historically abuses for DLL side-loading (PlugX, TONESHELL, PUBLOAD) executing from user-writable directories or removable media instead of their vendor install paths.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/g/earth-preta-uses-hiupan-malware-to-spread-plugx.html
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/china-nexus-espionage-southeast-asia
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/08/12
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0129
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_name:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AdobeUpdate.exe'
      - '\AdobeARM.exe'
      - '\AcroRd32.exe'
      - '\hkcmd.exe'
      - '\RasTls.exe'
      - '\AvastSvc.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\AvastEmUpdate.exe'
      - '\ESET.exe'
      - '\RtkAudUService64.exe'
      - '\nvSmartMax.exe'
      - '\NvSmart.exe'
      - '\BugSplatRC.exe'
      - '\GUP.exe'
      - '\vmtoolsd.exe'
  filter_legit_path:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
      - 'C:\Windows\'
      - 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_name and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Portable copies of legitimate utilities distributed by IT (rare; verify SHA256 vs vendor)
  - Software-deployment tooling that stages binaries in %TEMP% before install
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\AdobeUpdate.exe OR *\adobeupdate.exe OR *\AdobeARM.exe OR *\adobearm.exe OR *\AcroRd32.exe OR *\acrord32.exe OR *\hkcmd.exe OR *\HKCMD.EXE OR *\RasTls.exe OR *\rastls.exe OR *\AvastSvc.exe OR *\avastsvc.exe OR *\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\ESET.exe OR *\eset.exe OR *\RtkAudUService64.exe OR *\rtkaudUservice64.exe OR *\nvSmartMax.exe OR *\nvsmartmax.exe OR *\BugSplatRC.exe OR *\bugsplatrc.exe OR *\GUP.exe OR *\gup.exe OR *\vmtoolsd.exe OR *\VMTOOLSD.EXE) -@Image:(C:\Program\ Files\* OR C:\Program\ Files\ (x86)\* OR C:\Windows\* OR C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(AdobeUpdate|AdobeARM|AcroRd32|hkcmd|RasTls|AvastSvc|wsc_proxy|AvastEmUpdate|ESET|ESETOnlineScanner|RtkAudUService64|nvSmartMax|NvSmart|NVDisplay\.Container|BugSplatRC|GUP|vmtoolsd)\.exe$/i
| NOT (ImageFileName=/^C:\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\/i OR ImageFileName=/^C:\\Windows\\/i OR ImageFileName=/^C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Mustang Panda's PlugX, TONESHELL, PUBLOAD, MQsTTang and HORSESHELL loaders have used this same DLL-search-order hijack on Adobe/ESET/Avast/Realtek/NVIDIA/VMware binaries continuously since 2019. The actor copies the vendor's signed EXE to %APPDATA%\<random>\ (or a USB root) alongside their malicious sibling DLL — Defender's signature-only logic trusts the parent, so endpoint AV is blind. ucs.title: [LLM] Mustang Panda HIUPAN/MISTCLOAK USB worm — first-stage propagation to removable drive root
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's USB-worm propagation chain (HIUPAN, MISTCLOAK, U2DiskWatch) seen in Earth Preta campaigns 2022-2024: a previously-infected host writes the loader EXE + sideload DLL + a drive-named LNK ('Removable Disk.lnk', '<volume-label>.lnk') to the root of a freshly-inserted removable drive, with a hidden $RECYCLE.BIN-style folder used to stage the payload. This is one of the very few APT groups still actively weaponising USB drives at scale and the file-write fingerprint is highly specific.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_name) as files values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="D:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="E:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="F:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="G:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="H:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="I:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="J:\\*") (Filesystem.file_name="*.lnk" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.dll") NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","OneDrive.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","installer.exe") by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval ext=mvmap(files, lower(replace('files',"^.*\.(\w+)$","\1"))) | eval ext_count=mvcount(mvdedup(ext)) | where ext_count>=2 OR (mvfind(files,"\.lnk$")>=0 AND count>=2) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let WriteWindow = 7d;
let RemovableWrites = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(WriteWindow)
| where ActionType in~ ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
| where FolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
| where FileName endswith ".lnk" or FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","OneDrive.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","installer.exe","WindowsInstaller.exe","MsMpEng.exe","System")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Ext = tolower(extract(@"\.([a-z0-9]+)$", 1, FileName))
| extend DriveLetter = substring(FolderPath, 0, 2)
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileName, FolderPath, Ext, DriveLetter, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
RemovableWrites
| summarize WriteCount = count(),
            FilesWritten = make_set(FileName, 25),
            Extensions = make_set(Ext),
            FirstWrite = min(Timestamp),
            LastWrite = max(Timestamp),
            DropperPath = any(InitiatingProcessFolderPath),
            DropperCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, DriveLetter
// Worm signature: drops multiple types AND at least one .lnk masquerading as the drive
| where (array_length(Extensions) >= 2 and FilesWritten has_any (".lnk"))
   or (WriteCount >= 3 and Extensions has_any ("exe","dll"))
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WriteWindow = 7d;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(WriteWindow)
| where EventType =~ "FileCreated"
| where TargetFilePath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("lnk","exe","dll")
| where ActingProcessName !in~ ("explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","OneDrive.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","installer.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend DriveLetter = substring(TargetFilePath, 0, 2)
| summarize WriteCount = count(),
            Files = make_set(TargetFileName, 25),
            Extensions = make_set(TargetFileExtension),
            FirstWrite = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastWrite = max(TimeGenerated),
            DropperCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, DriveLetter
| where (array_length(Extensions) >= 2 and Files has_any (".lnk"))
   or (WriteCount >= 3 and Extensions has_any ("exe","dll"))
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:D:\\*.lnk OR @TargetFilename:E:\\*.lnk OR @TargetFilename:F:\\*.lnk OR @TargetFilename:G:\\*.lnk OR @TargetFilename:H:\\*.lnk OR @TargetFilename:I:\\*.lnk OR @TargetFilename:D:\\*.exe OR @TargetFilename:E:\\*.exe OR @TargetFilename:F:\\*.exe OR @TargetFilename:G:\\*.exe OR @TargetFilename:H:\\*.exe OR @TargetFilename:I:\\*.exe OR @TargetFilename:D:\\*.dll OR @TargetFilename:E:\\*.dll OR @TargetFilename:F:\\*.dll OR @TargetFilename:G:\\*.dll OR @TargetFilename:H:\\*.dll OR @TargetFilename:I:\\*.dll) -@Image:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.EXE OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\MSIEXEC.EXE OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\setup.exe OR *\SearchProtocolHost.exe) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/^[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.(lnk|exe|dll)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(explorer|msiexec|setup|OneDrive|SearchProtocolHost|installer|WindowsInstaller|MsMpEng)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| regex("(?P<drive>^[D-Z]:)", field=TargetFileName)
| regex("\\.(?P<ext>lnk|exe|dll)$", field=TargetFileName, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, drive],
          function=[count(), collect([TargetFileName, ext], multival=true)])
| _count >= 2
ucs.rationale: USB-based propagation has fallen out of favour with almost every modern APT — Mustang Panda is the conspicuous exception, with Trend Micro (Earth Preta, 2024), Avast (HIUPAN, 2023) and ESET (MISTCLOAK, 2024) all documenting active USB worming through 2024. The fingerprint — non-explorer process writing an LNK plus EXE/DLL combo to the root of a removable drive while the actor account is a real use
